new_libraries.name: ErovoutikaErobot
new_libraries.author: Engr. Dominik Niño
new_libraries.sentence: Complete robot control library for the ERovoutika educational robot platform.
new_libraries.paragraph: Provides built-in motor control (forward, backward, pivot turns, soft turns, manual move), multi-channel IR line-sensor calibration (5 or 8 channels), black/white line detection, and ready-to-use examples for line following, obstacle avoidance, soccer-bot, and mobile Bluetooth control.
